doc_line: --max-turns  Limit the number of agentic turns (print mode only). No limit by default.
conclusion: --max-turns is accepted in print mode even though `claude --help` does not list it (fixtures/help/claude.txt has no --max-turns line). The CLI reference documents it, so test/cli-help-contract.test.mjs allowlists this one flag with that URL. The same run also carries every other flag the claude adapter emits by default (-p, --output-format json, --permission-mode acceptEdits) plus --model, all accepted.
